confirm.disable: Disable the plugin {id}? The service restarts without it; its principal and its stored data stay in place, and it can be enabled again.
confirm.enable: Enable the plugin {id}? The service restarts to load it, and its principal holds the level its manifest asks for.

plugin.empty: No plugin is installed in the plugins directory

error.level: The plugin {id} asks for the level {level}, which a plugin may not hold
error.manifest: The manifest of the plugin {id} cannot be used: {reason}
error.not_started: The plugin module has not started
error.unavailable: The plugin {plugin} does not answer yet
